title: LintConfig
description: Configuration for the Dataverse lint rules. Every rule id has its own closed options schema under $defs/rules - add a new $defs/rules/<id> entry and register it in properties.rules when adding a rule, so existing rules can never regress.

rules.description: Rule registry keyed by rule id - only known rule ids are accepted

severity.description: Severity used when reporting findings for this rule

naming.unmanaged-field-logicalname.description: Validates unmanaged custom field logical names against the DIGITALL Nature naming convention (prfx_fieldname[_type-suffix])

publisherPrefixes.description: Allowed publisher prefixes (trailing underscore optional, it is added automatically). Default: dgt_

completeness.table-root-component-behavi.description: Ensures unmanaged tables are added completely (IncludeSubcomponents) and managed tables are never added completely (only their delta may be listed, or referenced as a shell)
